seo.title: Count Easy — Countdown & Days Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Beautiful countdown widgets for your home screen. Track days until vacations, birthdays, deadlines — or days since milestones. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: COUNTDOWN TRACKER
hero.title: Beautiful countdown widgets.
text: Track what matters. Days until your next vacation. Days since you started a new habit. Beautiful widgets that keep your important dates front and center.

screenshots.alt: Count Easy — Countdown to What Matters
screenshots.label: Countdown to What Matters

items.title: Days Until
items.text: Count down to future events — vacations, birthdays, weddings, deadlines, product launches, anything worth anticipating.

items.title: Days Since
items.text: Track milestones and achievements — sobriety dates, relationship anniversaries, habit streaks, career moments.

items.title: Repeating Events
items.text: Set annual repeating for birthdays and anniversaries. Count Easy automatically resets when the date passes.

items.title: Categories
items.text: Organize your countdowns with custom categories. Group work deadlines, personal goals, and celebrations separately.

items.title: Beautiful Widgets
items.text: Stunning home screen and lock screen widgets. Small, medium, and large sizes to fit your layout perfectly.

items.title: 8 Vibrant Colors
items.text: Choose from 8 accent colors for each countdown. Make important dates pop with colors that match your style.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your dates. Your device.
text: No accounts. No cloud sync. No tracking. No ads. Count Easy stores everything locally on your device. Your data never leaves.

cta.title: Start counting.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
